nodes.summary: Given probability mass functions $p$ and $q$ on a type $\alpha$, a constant $M \in [0, \infty]$ and a point $x \in \alpha$, the acceptance probability of the proposal $x$ is $p(x) / (M\,q(x))$, computed in $[0, \infty]$, where $a / 0 = \infty$ for $a \ne 0$ and $0 / 0 = 0$.

nodes.summary: For $r \in [0, \infty]$ with $r \le 1$, the biased coin with parameter $r$ is the probability mass function on $\{\mathrm{true}, \mathrm{false}\}$ that gives $\mathrm{true}$ probability $r$ and $\mathrm{false}$ probability $1 - r$.

nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $q$ be probability mass functions on $\alpha$ and $M \in [0, \infty]$ with $p(y) \le M\,q(y)$ for all $y \in \alpha$. For every $x \in \alpha$, one round of rejection sampling for target $p$, proposal $q$ and envelope $M$ yields the pair $(x, \mathrm{true})$, that is, proposes $x$ and accepts it, with probability $p(x) / M$.

nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $q$ be probability mass functions on $\alpha$ and $M \in [0, \infty]$ with $p(x) \le M\,q(x)$ for all $x \in \alpha$. Let $r$ be the sum over $x \in \alpha$ of the probabilities that one round of rejection sampling for target $p$, proposal $q$ and envelope $M$ yields $(x, \mathrm{false})$, that is, the probability that the round rejects. Then $r + M^{-1} = 1$.
nodes.title: Probability that a round rejects

nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $q$ be probability mass functions on $\alpha$ and $M \in [0, \infty]$ with $p(x) \le M\,q(x)$ for all $x \in \alpha$. The sum over $x \in \alpha$ of the probabilities that one round of rejection sampling for target $p$, proposal $q$ and envelope $M$ yields $(x, \mathrm{true})$ equals $M^{-1}$; that is, a round accepts with probability $1 / M$.
nodes.title: Probability that a round accepts

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
